app.name: Vertrix2 hardware check
app.short_description: Original VF loading and display check
app.long_description: Diagnostic only, not the complete game. Reads the original Vertrix2.vf from sd:/apps/vertrix2/Vertrix2.vf and displays a small original sprite on a black frame. HOME on Wii Remote 1 or START on GameCube controller 1 exits.
